authorized_scope: D1, D2 and D3; one image edit request each using the reviewed prompts, exact original reference and unchanged parameters; no automatic paid retries.
background_parameter_policy: Omit the API background parameter; request opaque flat RGB(0,159,62) in the prompt. Native alpha is not requested. Actual output background and palette require inspection.
negative_prompt_policy: Common exclusions are appended to each complete prompt; no separate negative_prompt API field.
prompt_assembly: For each request, concatenate COMMON PROMPT + the single matching pose section + COMMON EXCLUSIONS. Never send the full three-pose package as one prompt.

primary_reference.role: The only upload for all three independent requests: identity, armor, horse, tack, palette, lighting, anatomical scale and locked slightly elevated frontal camera. The standing/charging pose must change to the specified death phase.
primary_reference.transform: Byte-identical copy of existing Charging1 production plate; original 960px RGBA source padded by 32px on all sides over RGB(0,159,62), without rescaling, cropping or subject recoloring.

requests.key_acceptance: Front knees collapse and chest lowers; hind legs briefly brace; rider folds forward and sags right while hips stay near saddle; lance remains in anatomical right hand. No recovery or side-lying final pose yet.

requests.role_en: Side fall right, horse shoulder contact
requests.prompt_en_section: [D2: SIDE FALL RIGHT, HORSE SHOULDER CONTACT]
requests.key_acceptance: Horse shoulder contacts ground toward image right, hindquarters still slightly raised; rider follows later toward near-side ground; boots leave stirrups; lance starts releasing. Still visibly unsettled.

requests.role_zh: 人马倒地、最终收稳尾帧
requests.role_en: Settled rider and horse, final hold
requests.prompt_zh_section: 【D3动作：人马倒地、最终收稳尾帧】
requests.prompt_en_section: [D3: SETTLED RIDER AND HORSE, FINAL HOLD]
requests.key_acceptance: Horse and rider rest on same ground; rider visible near horse, limp and no longer seated; single released lance rests outside bodies; full opaque final silhouette without fade.

shared_acceptance: Same 109 identity, palette, material, equipment, anatomical scale and camera in all three images.
All falls toward image right; local body rotation is permitted, camera rotation and rigid rotation of standing sprite are excluded.
One rider, one horse, one straight complete lance; limbs, stirrups, reins and weapon relationships remain plausible.

At least 64px of margin around complete silhouette. No enlargement/recentering to fill the shorter fallen-pose frame. Approximate original support y=929 is an invisible ground reference, not a drawn guide.
No floor, shadow, effects, blood, motion blur, storyboard, text or baked-in fade.
Generated color and flatness are targets to inspect, not guaranteed by the prompt. D1/D2/D3 must remain visually distinct and sequentially coherent.

scope.future_generation_scope_if_user_approves: Three independent one-image edits using the same exact identity upload; one call per pose, no paid automatic retry.

known_limits: This is the frontal mounted-death set. Side-attack and rear-retreat death entrances require separate continuity assessment.
Dismounted 109 death remains a separate existing infantry flow.
Later deployment must reconcile the dedicated collapse with Enemy.cs generic death bounce/rotation and preserve one-time death/recycle semantics. No implementation is included here.
Independent generation can drift between poses; review consistency before video preparation. Changing reference roles or material parameters requires renewed prompt approval.
